blocks.text: You love that Febreze fights odors. But what you love even more? Febreze Unstopables Air Effects has up to 2X the incredibly fresh scent power (aka stronger fragrance intensity after 3 hours vs. base Febreze). Febreze fights stink with a neat little molecule called cyclodextrin (Bonus: It's naturally made from corn). This powerfully scented air freshener is always ready to send stinks packing with its bold scent: Just spray in a sweeping motion and clean the air in every room of the house. Unstopables Fresh takes your senses to vibrant new heights with invigorating aromas of citrus, tropical fruits, and florals. And, with its 100% natural propellant, you can confidently freshen up wherever and whenever you please. Want to take the fresh-tensity on the road? Try Febreze Unstopables CAR Vent Clips and drive odors out of town.
